versions.changelog:
Initial release of audio2srt-localgen: generate and deploy the Audio2SRT project fully offline on Apple Silicon Macs.

- Generates a complete Audio2SRT web app project locally from embedded templates with no network or git clone required.
- Installs all Python and Node.js dependencies, auto-downloads MLX Whisper and Qwen translation models, and launches backend (Python aiohttp, port 8765) plus frontend (Vite + React, port 3000).
- Supports flexible directory placement, prompts before overwriting existing dirs, and structures the project for immediate use.
- Provides automated troubleshooting steps and ensures smooth offline deployment.
